name: Massachusetts General Hospital
campus_description: Massachusetts General Hospital's main campus sits between Fruit Street, Cambridge Street, and the Charles River in Boston's West End. Inpatient care is centered in the historic Bulfinch, Ellison, and White buildings; outpatient services are spread across the Lunder, Yawkey, and Wang buildings; and Mass Eye & Ear is the standalone facility on Charles Street. Patient parking is in the Fruit Street, Yawkey, and Charles River Plaza garages, with Mass Eye & Ear served by the Charles Street lot.

buildings.name: Russell Museum of Medical History and Innovation

parking.name: Fruit Street Garage
parking.entrance_note: Main patient garage at 55 Fruit Street, just below the central campus. Take the elevator up to the lobby and follow signage to the building you need.

parking.name: Yawkey Garage
parking.entrance_note: Underground garage directly beneath the Yawkey Center. Take the garage elevator up to the Yawkey lobby; valet parking is also available at the Yawkey entrance off Cambridge Street.

parking.name: Charles River Plaza Garage
parking.entrance_note: Garage entrance at 207 Cambridge Street, next to Flour Bakery — serves the 165/175/185 Cambridge Street outpatient buildings on the east side of campus.

parking.name: North Grove Street Garage
parking.entrance_note: On North Grove Street between Cambridge and Fruit. Walk south on North Grove to enter the main campus near the Wang/Bulfinch buildings.

parking.name: Blossom Parking Garage
parking.entrance_note: On Blossom Street at the north edge of campus — closest to the Cox, Warren, and Shriners buildings.

parking.name: Charles Street Garage
parking.entrance_note: On Charles Street near the river — primarily serves the Massachusetts Eye and Ear building at 243 Charles Street.
